source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Press UID manually
2. Check the behavior and color of UID
3. Login BMC web press UID on.
4. Check the behavior and color of UID
5. Login BMC web press UID off.
6. Check the behavior and color of UID
7. Login BMC web and remote KVM.
8. Use ipmitool command light UID : ipmitool chassis identify
9. Check the behavior and color of UID

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Physical and WebUI UID LED should be bright Blue when turning on manually
2. Physical and WebUI UID LED should be OFF when turning off manually
3. Physical and WebUI UID LED should be bright Blue when turning on by BMC web control.
4. Physical and WebUI UID LED should be OFF when turning on BMC web control.
5. Physical and WebUI UID should be flashing when user remote the system.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: UID requires visual inspection of the BMC/front-panel LED; a physical/visual check a person must do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator visually records the LED state; agent cannot see LEDs.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: LED inspection is physical/visual - human only.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED due contradictory WebUI-on criteria.

original_test_intent: Validate physical-button, WebUI, KVM and IPMI UID controls against the chassis LED, but two criteria assign opposite states to the same WebUI-on action.
original_method: An engineer operates each control path and visually observes blue/off/flashing physical and WebUI indications.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer operates the physical/WebUI/KVM controls and visually observes the UID; the agent may support command logging only.
required_inputs: Exact chassis identity and final off state
safety_requirements: Verify the exact chassis before remote UID control.
Do not claim visual state from command success.
No automatic retry; return UID to approved state.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, capture command/WebUI state and correlate engineer-provided visual evidence.
Do not press hardware, certify LED state or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Correct matrix; operate and observe all control paths.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states visual core is not remotely provable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain documented ipmitool chassis identify only as one control path, not as visual proof.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All physical/WebUI/KVM/IPMI steps, contradictory criteria, script and 20/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correct the state matrix, then test each control independently with timestamps, physical/WebUI state correlation, identify timeout and final off restore.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes the WebUI-on contradiction and makes timeout explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves all four control paths and physical indication.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong-target control can misidentify a chassis.

project_override_considerations: Project timing/color rules may vary, but cannot silently resolve the contradictory Master Source; record the approved matrix.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criterion 3 requires bright blue for WebUI UID on, while Criterion 4 also says WebUI UID on must be OFF.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Two opposite physical outcomes are required for the same core action; manual execution cannot be judged until corrected.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Visual limitation correct but contradiction unresolved.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds exact restore and wrong-chassis protections.

review_improvement: Requires an unambiguous UID state machine before any physical or remote control claim.
independent_technical_reasoning: A single WebUI-on command cannot simultaneously require steady blue and off. The acceptance conflict is irreducible and affects the physical core, so MANUAL ONLY alone is insufficient.
